hooks.command: if [ "$(git branch --show-current)" = main ]; then git pull --ff-only -q; else git fetch -q origin main:main; fi 2>/dev/null && echo "local main synced to $(git rev-parse --short main)" || echo "local main NOT synced (diverged or offline); check before branching"; echo '--- STATE.md on main (a checkout can lag) ---'; git show main:STATE.md
